correctness.rationale: The exact four-mark generator is irreducible in continuous time for -1<=rho<1, with independent uniform headings redrawn on tumbles; stationary X is a damped stochastic convolution. The no-event decomposition gives Cov(V_t,V_(t+u))=s0 exp(-gamma |u|). The degree-four generator system yields Var X=s0/[mu(mu+gamma)]+D/mu and kappa4=6 s0^2/[mu^4(alpha+1)^2(alpha+3)]*[c(alpha+1)/(2+alpha(1-rho))-1]. Strict derivative in rho and one-sided rho->1 limit give unique sign threshold precisely when c(alpha+1)>2, with nonergodic endpoint excluded. An independently written exact SymPy four-mark stationary solver verified five rho settings, the zero at rho=7/10 and kappa4(9/10)=2/7 for mu=1,gamma=4,a=1,b=3. Thermal OU term changes only variance.
residual_risks: Finite rational checks do not prove all parameters; unrestricted conclusion follows generator algebra.
The rho=1 frozen-speed model is excluded from uniqueness.
